Coram : N. V. ANJARIA, N KOTISWAR SINGH*
Issue for Consideration Issue arose as regards the compensation to be paid under “parental consortium”; and the assessment of the monthly income of the deceased. Headnotes† Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 – s.166 – Compensation – Parental Consortium – Victim Personnel, earning Rs.9,000/- p.m., died in vehicular accident – Tribunal awarded Rs.8,44,000/- under various heads with interest at the rate of 7.5% p.a. from the date of petition till realisation, whereas the High Court enhanced the amount to Rs.11,00,672/-, with interest at 7.5% p.a.
Decision Date : 14-08-2026 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 10738/2026 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
